new_actual_source_reading.findings: The hazard model uses MHHW+0.6m datum. Erosion zones include historical extrema plus setbacks, interpolate between profiles, and assume defenses maintained/rebuilt without structural assessment. Cliff rates derive from aerial-photo comparisons; episodic failures resist average-rate prediction. Structure-risk lengths came from imagery without site inspections. CZMA/setbacks include modelled inundation. These methods describe hazards and management, not a uniform measured present shoreline or parish edge. No historical image acquisition dates were recovered in these passages.
